ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 4:1 white-to-black pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pixels localized at the continuous trailing edge margin, a central dark triangular region at the notch vertex, and scattered low-intensity linear and blob patterns across both white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; interior angle estimated at 42 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency deviations; macro-indentations present on the left lobe trailing edge and extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping outward from the notch, terminating in sharp upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, circular high-contrast pixel clusters concentrated on the right lobe mid-section and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear traces (rake marks) visible in diagonal and curved orientations across both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial irregular material loss along the trailing edge resulting in a highly serrated profile; extensive scarring/rake marks on right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique curvilinear pigmentation pattern on the right lobe medial-lateral region resembling concentric arcs.
